page.notes: The top paragraph is a continuation from the previous page. "de seloquens" is uncertain (the printed form looks like "feloquens", probably "se loquens"). The left column is set in italic; "accederet populi" continues at the end of the column, and the text of the right column continues on the next printed page. The top text and column text were read from the scan and may contain small errors. The long s is read as s throughout; "ff" in "successionem" is the printer's double long s.
